description: Change the title, description, access mode or paid access (is_paid, price in USD; needs a payout gateway connected by the user, otherwise NO_PAYOUT_GATEWAY; outside get_account saleBounds: 400 PRICE_BELOW_PLAN_MIN or PRICE_ABOVE_PLAN_MAX) of a stream card of the connected account. Access modes as in create_stream. To protect a stream with a password send visibility ACCESS_KEY together with access_key; to change the password of a stream that is already ACCESS_KEY send access_key alone (viewers who entered the old password are asked again). Moving to another mode removes the password. Switching to a narrower mode (PRIVATE, REGISTERED, ACCESS_KEY) takes effect for viewers who open the stream afterwards. Confirm a change of access mode or password with the user.

access_key.description: The password viewers must enter. Send it with visibility ACCESS_KEY, or alone on a stream that is already ACCESS_KEY to change it. Refused for any other mode.

hide_live_seek_bar.description: true: no seek bar for viewers while live

is_paid.description: true makes watching the stream paid (the DCAST player runs the paywall), false makes it free

keep_recording.description: false: the recording is deleted when the broadcast ends; not while live. Confirm first.

price.description: Price in USD; null clears it

show_live_viewers.description: true: the player shows the watching-now count

visibility.description: Access mode; the five modes are listed in create_stream

name: update_stream
title: Update stream details
